QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_49

question.text: Stakeholders in a Social Impact Assessment, per Section 5.7.1, include ALL of the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: Risk investors, impact investors, outcome funders
The SIA's personal family members solely by relationship to the assessor

explanation.text: The Logic: Workbook pp.119-120 list the SIA's stakeholders as the social enterprise, beneficiaries, investors, outcome funder, evaluators, intermediaries, regulators, communities, vendors, agencies, governments, fund providers, trustees, directors, and corporates. The SIA's personal family members, identified solely by their relationship to the assessor, are not on that stakeholder list. The Trap: A, B, and C are all explicitly listed on pp.119-120. D is the item not present in the stakeholder list. Note: The except-answer rests on the p.119-120 stakeholder list; stick to those entries when identifying or excluding stakeholders.
